requirement: A manual Website Opportunities build of a quickstart-first revision keeps its action open until the site's fill ends, instead of closing it and killing the fill

oracle.ref: PR #1646 (fix); fix evidence: Dev, 23/10/2026: a manual build of a quickstart-first WordPress revision ended its action completed 5 seconds after the site build; one second later the site's fill failed with QUICKSTART_ACTION_CLOSED because the fill writes only while its action is queued.
oracle.invariant: 0 failures. A manual quickstart-first action stays queued while the fill runs, completes when it applies and fails with SITE_FILL_FAILED when it fails, without QA retry or hand-off. A manual action whose site access is lost or whose site is deleted stops instead of waiting for the timeout. A manual legacy action still completes as soon as its site is built; automatic actions are unchanged.
oracle.productSourcesScope: file-level: the files the case imports, reads or runs (declaration line, or the first code line); the invariant is exercised through them, the executed assertion is the case command
productSourcesUnresolved: apps/tracy-web/src/db/index.js:52 readFile() with a computed path

writes: run dir under QA_ARTIFACT_ROOT: logs/, tmp/<case> (the child TMPDIR, removed after the run)
